info.title: Gorget REST API
info.description: The API behind the web console. Sign in with a session cookie (send X-CSRF-Token on writes) or use an API token: `Authorization: Bearer gat_...`. Tokens are read-only or read/write. IdP provisioning uses the separate SCIM 2.0 endpoint under /scim/v2.
